---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new rule, adapter, API capability, or deployment improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What interoperability/assurance problem does this solve? (e.g. "no rule exists
to validate X" or "no way to reconcile FHIR DiagnosticReport").

**Proposed solution**
Describe the rule, endpoint, adapter, or infra change you'd like.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Links to relevant HL7v2/FHIR spec sections, example messages, etc.
